title: A comparative pan-plastome analysis of carnivorous plants reveals structural conservatism in Nepenthes khasiana and lineage-specific loss and pseudogenization of ndh genes (data and code)
description: Data, analysis scripts and results accompanying the article submitted to Bioinformatics Advances (BIOADV-2026-545): GenBank accessions and records for 49 carnivorous plant plastomes and Amborella trichopoda, plastid ndh gene-status calls, codon alignments and IQ-TREE phylogeny, k-mer (Mash) and ANIb whole-plastome comparisons, RSCU/ENC codon-usage and dN/dS analyses, and the scripts that regenerate all figures and supplementary tables (run_all.sh).
